resumeText:
Priya Sharma | Indore, Madhya Pradesh | priya.sharma.db@example.com

EDUCATION
B.Tech, Computer Science and Engineering, Shri Govindram Institute of Technology, Indore (2022 - 2026) | CGPA 8.0/10

INTERNSHIP
Database Intern, Malwa Software Services, Indore (May 2025 - Jul 2025, 10 weeks)
- Wrote SQL queries in MySQL to generate monthly sales and stock reports for a distributor client.
- Added indexes after reading EXPLAIN output and cut a slow report query from 14 seconds to 2 seconds.
- Wrote a Bash script with mysqldump to take nightly backups and run it with cron.

PROJECTS
- MySQL replication lab (academic, Advanced DBMS course): Set up MySQL source-replica replication between two Ubuntu Linux virtual machines and tested failover by stopping the source.
- Library management database (academic, DBMS course): Designed a normalised schema for books, members and loans and wrote stored procedures as part of the DBMS course.

COURSEWORK AND CERTIFICATIONS
- Coursework: DBMS, Advanced DBMS, Operating Systems, Computer Networks
- Oracle Database SQL fundamentals (online course)

SKILLS
SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL basics, Linux, Bash, Database security, Python basics

ACTIVITIES
- Volunteer, coding club teaching SQL to second-year students
- College basketball team
